title: Experience Cloud Site
description: Represents a Salesforce Experience Cloud site (community) with its configuration, status, and access settings.

id.description: Unique 18-character Salesforce identifier for the site

name.description: Display name of the Experience Cloud site

status.description: Current operational status of the site

urlPathPrefix.description: URL path prefix for the site, appended to the domain

siteUrl.description: Full URL of the Experience Cloud site

loginUrl.description: URL for the site login page

templateName.description: Name of the template used to create the site

allowChatterAccessWithoutLogin.description: Whether guest users can access Chatter content without logging in

allowMembersToFlag.description: Whether community members can flag content for moderation

invitationsEnabled.description: Whether site administrators can send invitations to join

knowledgeableEnabled.description: Whether the knowledgeable people feature is enabled

memberVisibilityEnabled.description: Whether members can see other members in the site

nicknameDisplayEnabled.description: Whether nicknames are displayed instead of full names

privateMessagesEnabled.description: Whether private messaging between members is enabled

reputationEnabled.description: Whether the reputation and points system is enabled

sendWelcomeEmail.description: Whether welcome emails are sent to new members

siteAsContainerEnabled.description: Whether the site-as-container feature is enabled for embedding

url.description: API resource URL for this site
